title: Bug fix across modules (checkout totals)
prompt: This repo is a small checkout library (package `shop/`). The test suite is failing and customers report wrong totals. Read SPEC.md, find and fix every bug in the `shop` package so it behaves exactly as SPEC.md says. Keep the public API the same. Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`. Note the visible tests do not cover every rule in SPEC.md. When you are done, stop.
